title: Reader theme swatch borders leak Material surface colors
symptom: The reader settings color swatches rendered their selected and unselected borders from MaterialTheme colorScheme values instead of the active reader palette. A Pixel 8 / Android 14 Compose pixel regression confirmed the selected swatch could display a Material onSurface trap color and the unselected swatch could display a Material outline trap color.
root_cause: ReaderThemeSwatch used preset colors for the swatch fill but kept the border on a separate styling path through MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurface and outline. That repeated the settings-sheet theme leak class where child controls are not fully driven by ReaderThemePalette.
fix: Render selected and unselected swatch borders from themePalette.content with different alpha values.
Add an instrumented Compose pixel-capture regression that sets Material onSurface and outline to trap colors and asserts theme swatches do not render them.
failed_attempts: Checking only semantic labels such as `当前主题：纸白` would not catch this class; the labels remain correct while the rendered border color leaks.
Only testing primary/accent colors is not sufficient for reader settings controls because Material surface roles such as onSurface and outline can also leak into overlay children.
impact: Keeps the reader settings color picker visually consistent with the active day/night reader theme and prevents unrelated Material surface colors from appearing in the reader overlay.
